description: This file defines the QLDBClient class for interacting with the Amazon QLDB service, including method annotations for API operations and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: QLDBClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon QLDB service, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: cancelJournalKinesisStream
methods.description: Cancels a Journal Kinesis stream.

methods.name: cancelJournalKinesisStreamAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a Journal Kinesis stream.

methods.name: createLedger
methods.description: Creates a new ledger in QLDB.

methods.name: createLedgerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new ledger in QLDB.

methods.name: deleteLedger

methods.description: Asynchronously describes a Journal Kinesis stream.

methods.description: Asynchronously describes a Journal S3 export.

methods.name: describeLedger

methods.description: Asynchronously describes a ledger.

methods.name: getBlockAsync

methods.name: getDigest
methods.description: Gets the digest of a journal.

methods.name: getRevision
